We first inspect ... we use GPT-3.5-turbo (and, in particular, the snapshot from June 13th 2023) to produce a detailed paragraph describing the triplet. ... We publicly release the Fakepedia-base dataset, comprising 6,090 counterfactual paragraph descriptions.

This work makes three distinct contributions: (a) introducing a counterfactual dataset designed to measure the abilities of LLMs to ground their answer in the new information provided in the prompt, (b) conducting a descriptive analysis of grounding performances across several LLMs, and (c) implementing an improved causal mediation analysis that we use to show that computation patterns inside LLMs can predict whether the answer is grounded.
outputs: Generated object tokens or choices in multiple-choice questions for factual triplets.

The outputs are model-generated answers to queries about the object of a fact triplet, either as next-token predictions or multiple-choice selections, based on counterfactual paragraphs in the prompt.
